dct_description_sm: Approximately 65,000+ penalty notices (parking tickets) are issued annually across the City of Brampton from 2012 through 2018. This dataset contains non-identifiable information relating to each penalty notice issued for each calendar year. Penalty notices are issued by City of Brampton By-law Enforcement Officers as well as persons certified and authorized to issue penalty notices by the City of Brampton.This dataset contains the last three digits of the penalty notice number, the date and time of issuance, the location of the offence and the type of infraction. License plate information is not available. For more information about parking by-laws in the City of Brampton, Click Here.
